verdict.rationale: Undermind's homepage describes a higher plan tier only in relative terms ('10x higher usage limits', unlimited workspaces/files/libraries) and mentions centralized team billing. A community user cites a $20/month subscription, but no first-party pricing figures or absolute limit numbers appear in the evidence. missing for 10: published plan prices, concrete per-plan usage limits (e.g. searches per month), a free-tier definition, enterprise pricing details, and independent corroboration of the limits.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can understand plan pricing and usage limits before committing
